Message:
workqueue: swap set_cpus_allowed_ptr() and PF_NO_SETAFFINITY

Move the setting of PF_NO_SETAFFINITY up before set_cpus_allowed()
in create_worker(). Otherwise userland can change ->cpus_allowed
in between.
